title: Create a backup stays enabled when nothing is recorded since the newest backup
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): O, seat A's cookie, api, pq, and one browser context for A with {locale:'en-US', colorScheme:'light', viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}}; never close pages or contexts.
S2: Pick S = a site A owns where backups may be created (scv2 stand: qa1wp01.scv2.tracy.test; any CMS).
S3: Run api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-001-base","notes":""}' and record N = body.version.

S4: Open Site changes as A: goto O/<S>; wait until the URL contains '/s/session-' and "[contenteditable='true']" exists (≤90 s); goto that URL with query tab=tracy:changes&site=<S>; wait for '.tv-activity-v2' and until '.tv-activity-v2 [data-reading]' is absent (≤90 s); wait for "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>']" (≤60 s, one reload allowed).

S5: Evaluate and record: e = document.querySelector('.tv-activity-v2 li[data-event]'); b = document.querySelector('[data-create-backup]'); {first: e.dataset.event, disabled: b.disabled, hasDisabledAttr: b.hasAttribute('disabled'), title: b.getAttribute('title')}.

S6: Click '[data-create-backup]'; wait for '[role=dialog] [data-draft]' (≤10 s); fill '#tracy-backup-title' (the title field, after the fixed 'Backup N ·') with 'REG-001-after'; click "[role=dialog] [data-slot='dialog-footer'] button:last-child".

S7: Poll api a GET /api/sites/<S>/backups every 2 s (≤120 s) until a row with kind 'backup' and version > N exists; record that row and whether "[role=dialog][data-slot='dialog-content']" is still in the DOM.
expect: S5: first == 'backup-<N>' (the state under test: newest timeline entry is a backup); any other value → BLOCKED (something was recorded after the backup), rerun from S3.
S5: disabled == false and hasDisabledAttr == false (pre-fix: both true).
S5: title starts with 'Nothing recorded in Site changes since Backup <N>.' (pre-fix title: 'Nothing new since Backup <N>').
S7: new row version == N+1, title == 'REG-001-after', database.state == 'full'; no "[role=dialog][data-slot='dialog-content']" left in the DOM.
evidence: tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/qa/r1/bugs/QA-I07.md (fix 6609ec20f); the QA note is Studio-local (not in git), the fix commit is on develop
fence: packages/core/tracy-core/src/site-tabs/ChangesView.tsx renders [data-create-backup] with no disabled prop; nothingRecordedSince() (backup-list.ts) only sets its title when the newest timeline entry is a backup.
